Historical weather for the Dobson Ranch operating window

Source: R/weather.R
prepare_dobson_weather.Rd

Reads the bundled NOAA GHCND extract. Temperature and wind are Phoenix Sky Harbor (USW00023183), about 13.91 km from the course centroid. Precipitation is the Mesa 4.3 SW CoCoRaHS gauge (US1AZMR0260), about 0.81 km away. That gauge does not report temperature or wind. Sky Harbor precipitation is kept in precip_mm_airport and is not copied into the local precipitation column.

Usage

prepare_dobson_weather(path = NULL)

Arguments

path

Optional path to a weather CSV built by data-raw/dobson_weather.R. The station CSV must sit beside it.

Value

A golfops_course_weather tibble. timing is observed. Attributes stations, coverage, units, and decisions record provenance and missingness.

Details

GHCND stores temperature and precipitation and wind in tenths. This file stores degrees Celsius, millimeters, and meters per second. temp_avg_c is the average of the daily minimum and maximum. GHCND TAVG is empty for Sky Harbor on every day in this window, so the average is not an hourly mean.

A non-blank GHCND quality flag withdraws that value. The flag is kept. A measurement flag of T is a trace: precipitation is 0 and precip_trace is TRUE. Multiday accumulations are not assigned to one date. Missing gauge days stay missing.

The extract was retrieved from NCEI on 2026-11-19 and restricted to 2021-07-01 through 2026-04-30, including 2024-12-10. Examples, tests, and the vignette read this file. They do not call a weather service. GHCND is a U.S. government work.

The course coordinate is the OpenStreetMap centroid of relation 326342, retrieved the same day. It is not a surveyed tee.

Examples

weather <- prepare_dobson_weather()
range(weather$date)
#> [1] "2021-07-01" "2026-04-30"
attr(weather, "coverage")
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   variable          n_days n_missing pct_missing
#>   <chr>              <int>     <int>       <dbl>
#> 1 temp_min_c          1765         0        0   
#> 2 temp_max_c          1765         0        0   
#> 3 temp_avg_c          1765         0        0   
#> 4 precip_mm           1765       139        7.88
#> 5 precip_mm_airport   1765         0        0   
#> 6 wind_speed_ms       1765         2        0.11
